name: Call Me Blessed
overview: Scripture reveals that to be called blessed is a mark of God's favor and purpose, as seen in His promise to Abraham to make him a blessing to others. The Psalms emphasize that the upright and those who walk in God's ways will be blessed, with their names enduring and generations prospering. Jesus' teaching in the Sermon on the Mount highlights that true blessedness belongs to the humble in spirit and to peacemakers, who are recognized as God's children. Additionally, the honor of being called blessed extends to godly relationships, exemplified by the praise a virtuous woman receives from her family.
